Rough: "They drew a lottery in my name and called me mad - the sky's burden of trust could not be drawn." Might be about being labeled mad, burden of trust.

Option 3: "مرا گناه خود است ار مالمت تو برم - که عشق بار گران بود و من ظلوم جهول"

Rough: "My sin is my own if you blame me - that love was heavy and I was innocent and foolish." Might be about guilt and love's weight.

Rough: "I have drawn many times the burden of separation on my heart - I fear that the heart is weak and this burden will not be borne." About separation burden.
